name: Progressive ClipPath Curve Drawing
visual_intent: Progressively discloses complex mathematical curves, loss gradients, or metric graphs cleanly from left to right.

parameters.name: clipRectSelector
parameters.description: Selector for rectangle element inside SVG <clipPath>.

parameters.name: chartWidth
parameters.description: Final target width of clipping mask in pixels.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Timestamp in seconds to begin curve revelation.

timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Synchronized with voice narration explaining model convergence or metric trend.

code_snippet.html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="chart-clip">
      <rect id="clip-rect" x="70" y="0" width="0" height="400" />
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  <path d="M 70 380 Q 250 350, 400 180 T 700 80" stroke="#3fb950" stroke-width="3" clip-path="url(#chart-clip)" fill="none" />
</svg>

fallbacks: Stroke-dashoffset reveal on path element if clipPath is unsupported.
validation_steps: Snapshot at startTime + (duration / 2) to confirm partial curve disclosure.
Snapshot at startTime + duration to confirm complete curve rendering without clipping.
